p: God said unto Jacob: God is ever at hand to comfort his people in their troubles.
clean: That by this outward act they should show their inward repentance.
For in this was some sign of superstition, as in tablets and Agnus deis (a cake of wax, stamped with a lamb bearing a cross or flag, that has been blessed by the Pope).
Thus, despite the inconvenience that came before, God delivered Jacob.
went up from him in the: As God is said to descend, when he shows some sign of his presence: so he is said to ascend when a vision is ended.
little way to come to Ephrath: The Hebrew word signifies as much ground as one can cover from resting point to resting point, which is taken for half a days journey.
pillar upon her grave: The ancient fathers used this ceremony to testify their hope of the resurrection to come, which was not generally revealed.
lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: This teaches that the fathers were not chosen for their merits, but only by God's mercies, whose election was not changed by their faults.
